'''Nitram''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] and a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who served alongside [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] on the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] during the [[1 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He acted as Eclipse's second-in-command during a [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|brief battle]] over [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. He was killed onboard the ''Salvation'' by [[Terror Trooper]]s led by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] during the [[Battle near the Itani Nebula]].
